title: Insurance and Other Assistance Given to Injured NSmen
what_it_is: Insurance and Other Assistance Given to Injured NSmen

sections.label: MINDEF medical coverage for NSmen
sections.summary: MINDEF pays all necessary medical expenses for service-related injuries at Government restructured hospitals, clinics and community hospitals, and expands coverage and compensation if conditions worsen.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: MINDEF provides full medical coverage for service-related injuries by paying for all necessary medical expenses incurred by the NSman at Government restructured hospitals, clinics and community hospitals, for as long as required.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: This includes the costs of medical supplies and equipment, as well as specialist care.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Should the service-related injury be aggravated, or if there are new medical conditions arising from the injury, MINDEF will expand the scope of medical coverage to cover those conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: MINDEF will also provide higher compensation amounts if there is an increase in the degree of permanent disability.
